question: Should ClawHub expose claimState, officialState, and restrictionState as the admin official-publisher API vocabulary now, or keep this as a spec-only/internal model until account/feed state work is broader?
rationale: The PR creates a new trust-state API vocabulary; source review can catch derivation bugs, but only maintainers can decide whether this is the contract downstream clients should see.

options.title: Land after derivation and proof
options.body: Accept the separated state vocabulary, but only after the active-user bug is fixed and runtime/API proof is posted.

options.title: Split spec from API field
options.body: Land the intent/spec first and defer the admin response field until the broader publisher-state contract is approved.

options.title: Pause this vocabulary
options.body: Keep current official-publisher API shape and revisit claim/restriction fields with the account-feed work.

recommendation.title: Land after derivation and proof
recommendation.body: Accept the separated state vocabulary, but only after the active-user bug is fixed and runtime/API proof is posted.

likelyOwner.reason: The new field is added to the official-publisher admin response and client schema areas currently blamed to Patrick Erichsen.
